faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Legal Services Authority Cachar (DLSA Cachar) for engaging dedicated individuals into contractual roles.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for DLSA Cachar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being carried out for the post of Para Legal Volunteer to assist individuals from marginalized sections of society.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form is 09-10-2026. Applicants must ensure their forms reach the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DLSA Cachar Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted exclusively through offline mode. Candidates need to download the form, fill it out, and send it via post or designated submission channels.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants should be literate, and preferably matriculate, possessing a strong capacity for overall comprehension, compassion, and concern for the upliftment of marginalized sections.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories. The application fee for all categories is Nil.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for DLSA Cachar Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit required to apply for the Para Legal Volunteer position is 18 years. Please refer to the official notification for complete details.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or honorarium provided for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive an honorarium that is fixed by the District Legal Services Authority from time to time as per the guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DLSA Cachar Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Para Legal Volunteer position primarily involves document verification to check the credentials and eligibility of the applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the Important Links section in this article and clicking on the designated official notification link.
